attorneys: Charles C. Wise, Jr. and Edward S. Pinney for appellant., John G. Fox, Attorney General of West Virginia, for appellee.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam: Charles C. Wise, Jr. and Edward S. Pinney for appellant. John G. Fox, Attorney General of West Virginia, for appellee.
